notes.title: Mac Support
notes.content: Unscramble Heroes is now available for Apple Silicon and Intel 64-bit systems.

notes.title: Prerelease Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Adjusted word dictionary.
[*]Rebalanced triggers for victory screen tip conditions.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update 1 - Bugfix 1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed bombs pulsing during boss runs.
[*]Fixed text boxes not allowing tutorial to advance when clicked on.
[*]Created a bug report forum. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2152000/discussions/2/]Bug Forum[/url]
[*]Created a subreddit. [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/UnscrambleHeroes/]r/UnscrambleHeroes/[/url]
[*]Added crash reporting diagnostics.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update 1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Getting a full boss word deals double damage.
[*]Rebalanced achievements.
[*]Loading screen indicator.
[*]Bomb icon pulses when overwhelmed to remind you to use them.
[*]Some alternate anagrams are solvable, such as cloud vs could.
[*]You can now unlock and play on different levels.
[*]Level choice determines word and boss difficulty, as well as bonus experience.
[*]Bosses spawn faster on lower difficulties and slower on higher difficulties to balance the extra experience at higher levels.
[*]Unlimited difficulty now locked to level 15.
[*]A brief tutorial has been added.
[*]When you first become eligible for a new level, the play again button will revert to the level selection screen.
[*]New achievements for reaching certain levels.
[/list]
